content: This product may not necessarily be safe, effective, or suitable for your use. The information provided here is not intended to replace personalized medical advice and should not be used as a substitute for consultation with your healthcare provider. Always consult your healthcare provider for comprehensive information about this product and your specific health needs. Drug Interactions: Drug interactions can alter the effectiveness of your medications or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. Maintain a list of all products you use, including prescription drugs, over-the-counter medications, and herbal supplements, and share this list with your doctor and pharmacist. This medication may interfere with certain laboratory tests, such as specific diabetic urine tests, potentially leading to inaccurate results. Overdose: In the event of an overdose with severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. For less urgent cases, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222, and Canadian residents can call 1-844-764-7669. This medication has been prescribed specifically for your current condition. If you are using this medication for an extended period, laboratory and/or medical tests (e.g., kidney and liver function tests, complete blood counts) should be conducted regularly to monitor your health. Ensure you attend all scheduled medical and laboratory appointments. Missed Dose: If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is close to the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up. Storage: Store this medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. Important Information: This document is a summary and does not contain all possible information about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. This information is not a substitute for individualized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare provider for complete information about this product and your specific health needs. Formulary Information: Adding plans allows you to compare the formulary status of this drug with others in the same class. To view formulary information, first create a list of plans. Your list will be saved and can be edited at any time. Individual plans may vary, and formulary information is subject to change. Contact the applicable plan provider for the most current information.
